summary: Tested ambassador pay links (backend + UI), the public /pay page on Niftipay, and the admin modal regression. Backend: forced AMYTEST code, 10% discount, custom-line 400, 401 without a token, ambassador-only list, and the admin list all work. CRITICAL UI BUG: the ambassador 'New pay link' modal has an EMPTY product dropdown. CreatePaylinkModal calls Products.listAll() -> GET /api/products/all, which is admin-only (require_admin), so the ambassador gets 403 and the error is silently swallowed (setProducts([])). Ambassadors cannot create a pay link from the UI at all. To test the pay page I created a link through the API instead. Pay page: discounted total £49.50 (-£5.50 AMYTEST) is correct, the address form saves, the paused banner shows, and the 'Pay by Card' button is greyed out. Admin modal regression is OK: 'Other (custom line)' and the Promo code input are both present.

critical.issue: Admin-only. The ambassador token gets 403, so the ambassador pay-link modal's product list is empty and the feature cannot be used from the UI.

qty is not validated. Accepted: items=[] (an order with shipping only), qty=0, and qty=-3 (subtotal goes negative, total clamps to the £4.99 shipping). Mixed lines are an exploit: qty 3 plus qty -2 of a £55 product gives subtotal £55 and total £49.50, while the stored items list 3x and -2x. Add qty>=1 (Field(ge=1)) and min_length=1 on items.

minor.issue: An admin token returns 400 'No ambassador code on your account' instead of 403. require_ambassador lets admins through.
New paylink orders still store payment_provider='paypal'. This is a leftover; it should be niftipay or empty.

ui_bugs.issue: The product dropdown shows 0 options because /products/all returns 403. The failure is silent, with no error toast. Fix: use the public Products.list() (GET /api/products) when the ambassador prop is set, or add an ambassador-accessible endpoint.

integration_issues.flow: Ambassador create pay link -> success URL -> list refresh
integration_issues.issue: Could not run end to end in the UI because no product can be chosen. The API-created link does appear correctly in the list, and in the admin list.

issues: BankTrustBadges ('Connects securely to your bank · FCA-regulated · Lloyds, NatWest...') is still shown under the Pay by Card button. This is open-banking copy and misleading for card checkout.
The footer still says 'Pay by Bank' (Footer.jsx:62).

passed_tests: Ambassador sidebar 'Pay links' nav goes to /ambassador/paylinks
ambassador-paylinks-page stats (1 / 1 / £0.00); GHP-069 row: Awaiting payment, £72.00, −£8.00 code applied, Copy link button
Modal: ambassador-paylink-note mentions AMYTEST and 10% off; no Promo code input; no 'Other (custom line)' option (the list is empty anyway)
API: promo_code in the body is overridden to AMYTEST; discount = 10% of subtotal; custom line -> 400 'Only catalogue products can be added'; no token -> 401 on POST and GET
GET /api/ambassadors/paylinks returns only this ambassador's links; admin GET /api/orders/paylinks includes them
Anonymous /pay/{id}: summary is correct, the UK address saves (verified via GET), the paused banner shows, Pay by Card is greyed out (pointer-events-none wrapper) and calls Niftipay.createPayment
Admin /admin/orders Create pay link modal: 83 options including 'Other (custom line)', and the Promo code field is present
action_items: CRITICAL: in CreatePaylinkModal, load products from the public GET /api/products when ambassador mode is on (or open /products/all to ambassadors), and show an error toast if loading fails
HIGH: validate PaylinkItemIn.qty >= 1 and items non-empty (Pydantic Field(ge=1), min_length=1) for both the admin and ambassador paylink endpoints
Minor: return 403 for non-ambassador tokens on /api/ambassadors/paylink; set payment_provider to niftipay on paylink orders; remove the bank trust badges and 'Pay by Bank' copy from the card checkout
critical_code_review_comments: CreatePaylinkModal swallows the products fetch error (.catch(() => setProducts([]))), which hid the 403
PayLinkPage still uses wallid* naming (wallidConfig, payWithWallid) although it calls Niftipay. Rename for maintainability.

The ambassador discount depends on the db.promos record for the code being active, unexpired, within max_uses and above min_subtotal. If the promo is deactivated, the discount silently becomes 0 and promo_code=None, so the sale would not count as commission.
seed_data_creation: Created test orders (TEST_ customer names) through the ambassador API and deleted each one by id with the admin token. Note: the order counter advanced, and GHP-075 was used and then deleted. payments_paused was not touched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/test_ambassador_paylinks.py -v -p no:xdist. After the qty fix, test_invalid_items and test_admin_token... should pass (test_admin_token expects 401/403). test_list_only_own asserts every ambassador link has promo_code=AMYTEST. UI: inject localStorage ghp_token plus sessionStorage ghp_age_verified='true' and ghp_site_unlocked='1'. Radix Select options are [role=option]. Pay page testids: pay-first-name, pay-last-name, pay-email, pay-phone, pay-address1, pay-city, pay-postcode, pay-continue-btn.
rca of the issue: Empty ambassador product dropdown: CreatePaylinkModal.jsx line 26 calls Products.listAll() (lib/api.js:45 -> GET /products/all). product_routes.py:52 guards that route with Depends(require_admin), so an ambassador JWT gets 403 and the catch sets products to []. Repro: log in as amb.test, go to /ambassador/paylinks, click New pay link, open the product select: there are 0 options. Fix: use GET /api/products for ambassadors.
